content.title: Hulu + Live TV plans
content.text: When you subscribe to one of our Live TV plans you’ll have access to everything in the Hulu streaming library, plus 95+ live TV channels you can watch at home or on-the-go. Select an option from the list below to learn more about our Live TV plans: Live TV plansAdd-onsWhat live content can I watch?Hulu + Live TV featuresHow do I sign up for Hulu + Live TV?I'm having trouble Live TV Plans Choose from the following Live TV plans from Hulu: Hulu + Live TV, Disney+, and ESPN SelectHulu Premium + Live TV, Disney+ Premium, and ESPN SelectHulu + Live TV, Disney+ Premium, and ESPN SelectHulu + Live TV Español, Disney+Live TV Only gives subscribers access to live content only and does not include the Hulu streaming library or access to Disney+.Live TV Only Español gives subscribers access to Spanish-language channels only and does not include the Hulu streaming library or access to Disney+. When you sign up for one of our Hulu + Live TV plans you’ll get access to live streams and additional on-demand content from your favorite sports, entertainment, and news channels, as well as content on Disney+ and ESPN apps. Aside from Hulu's Live TV Español plans, all of Hulu's Live TV plans include access to the full ESPN Unlimited experience within the ESPN app. While you’ll see that Hulu + Live TV includes ESPN Select, you will also get: The ESPN networks available through your Live TV subscription in the Hulu appAll other ESPN networks and services (including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPNEWS, ESPN+, ESPN Deportes, and ESPN on ABC) through ESPN Unlimited when you log into the ESPN app. BACK TO TOP Add-ons In addition to Premium and Partner Add-ons (like HBO Max, Paramount+ with SHOWTIME, Cinemax, and STARZ), the following Live TV Add-ons are available for an extra monthly charge: Unlimited Screens*Entertainment Networks** Sports Add-on** Español Networks** *Not available for purchase with the Live TV Only Español plan. **Not available for purchase with the Hulu + Live TV Español, Disney+ or the Live TV Only Español plans. BACK TO TOP What live content can I watch? Live TV subscribers can watch live sports, breaking news, awards shows, primetime dramas, daytime soaps, local teams and weather forecasts, the latest Hulu Originals, and thousands of shows and movies in the Hulu streaming library. National news, sports, and entertainment There are over 95 live and on-demand channels to choose from, including: Popular entertainment channels like BET, Comedy Central, Freeform, Hallmark Channel, Lifetime, MTV, OWN, TBS, TNT, and VH1Family-friendly channels like Cartoon Network, Disney Channel, Nickelodeon, and Nick Jr.Educational channels like Discovery, History, and National GeographicNational sports channels like ESPN, ESPN2, FS1, SEC Network, BTN, and ACC NetworkNational news channels CNN, Fox News, ABC News, The Weather Channel Local and regional channels Follow your local news, forecasts, and games on ABC, CBS, CW, and FOX affiliates in most cities. We also carry select regional sports networks across the country — enter your ZIP code here to see which channels are available in your area. Network On-Demand Each network also offers a wide variety of on-demand shows and movies from their libraries. There are some cases where we only have select seasons/episodes of a show in the Hulu streaming library, but additional ones are provided by the network. Keep in mind that Network On-Demand videos may still have ads, even if you subscribe to Hulu Premium + Live TV. *Live programming subject to regional availability, blackouts, and device restrictions BACK TO TOP Hulu + Live TV Features Cloud DVR With Cloud DVR, you won’t miss out on news, sports, movies, or shows you love. Unlimited DVR storageFast forward through recorded contentSelect the Record button to set up recordingsNavigate to the Manage DVR section in My Stuff to watch or delete recordings Keep in mind that there will be ad breaks in your recordings, however you can fast forward through the ads on recorded content. Live Guide The Live Guide makes it easy to see what’s airing now and coming up over the next two weeks. Filter your view by recent channels, genres, and moreCheck for blackouts on big games and sporting eventsSet up Cloud DVR recordings while you browse Other Features* Watch in up to 1080p/60fps and listen in 2.0 stereo and 5.1 surround soundStream different channels on two screens at a timeAutoplay when you want to bingeCreate up to six Profiles for everyone in your householdImprove your recommendations with numerous personalization features *Support for these features may be limited to select devices and/or content. BACK TO TOP How do I sign up for Hulu + Live TV? There are no hidden fees, equipment rentals, or installation appointments with Hulu. After you sign up, you can change or cancel your subscription at any time.* You’ll need to be located within the U.S. with a valid form of payment if you plan to subscribe to one of our Live TV plans. Make sure you also have: A device that supports the latest Hulu app and live TVA residential, non-mobile internet connection to set as your Home networkA download speed of at least 8mbps for smooth live streams New to Hulu? Sign up for Hulu + Live TV here. If you’d prefer a Hulu Premium + Live TV plan, you can change your plan on your Account page after signing up. Already have Hulu? If you subscribe to Hulu or Hulu Premium but want Live TV too, visit your Account page to change your plan and manage your add-ons. *Changing a plan from Live TV to Hulu take effect as of the next billing cycle; you will have continued access to your subscription for the remainder of that period but will not receive a refund.
